name: @vip/storage
description: Tenant-isolated object storage (Phase 1, P1-4): an S3/MinIO wrapper that requires a TenantContext and enforces the `{tenantId}/{cameraId}/…` object-prefix (fail-closed), plus short-lived signed URLs. The MinIO counterpart of @vip/tenancy's fail-closed Mongo guard. See docs/architecture/phase1/STORAGE_ARCHITECTURE.md, 18-DATA-ARCHITECTURE.
